query.description: The skill or ash-of-war name as the user wrote it. Variants are separate families — 'Transient Moonlight' is R1 and R2 — so a bare name is often ambiguous.

weapon_class.description: The class of weapon the ash is going on. It matters for the twenty-odd ashes whose hits differ by weapon: Sword Dance is three hits on a reaper and three different ones on a dagger. Without it, an ash that varies is reported for one variant and `variant_used` says which.
